scope: TP8 EP1 full-target DSpark C32; original weights; 1M token pool
controlled_difference: AR grid12 and C128 CK fixed; A=C4 Triton, B=refined C4 CK
protocol: Fresh process per arm, one excluded warm and one measured natural-EOS max2048 wave
metric: Common resident decode interval, excluding prefill and batch drain; not whole-wave wall time
limitations: Single ABBA screen, not statistical confidence.
Repetition screen is not executable-code correctness.
Neither control nor candidate is assumed whole-model bitwise deterministic.
Request acceptance is not resident-window acceptance accounting.
No proof that probability rounding caused the historical loop.
Do not add percentages from separate communication/C128/C4 comparisons.
decision: Retain refined C4 as an explicit opt-in screened candidate; conservative full-target profile remains C4 off. No whole-model determinism or historical-loop root-cause claim.
